create_augmentpipe: create an AugmentPipe module to apply configurable image augmentations including flips, rotations, and color transforms
build_augmentpipe_forward: build a forward pass through AugmentPipe to augment a batch of images with geometric and color transforms
review_augmentpipe_init: review the AugmentPipe constructor to configure augmentation probabilities for xflip, rotate, brightness, contrast, and noise
test_matrix_helpers: test the matrix helper functions translate2d, scale2d, rotate2d, translate3d, scale3d, and rotate3d for transformation matrices
summarize_wavelets: summarize the wavelets dictionary containing haar, db1-db8, and sym2-sym8 wavelet decomposition low-pass filter coefficients
